newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks recoup, close higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks recoup, close higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks, recouping from early lows, closed higher on Thursday on blue chip buying by investors before the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 1.74 points, or 0.12 percent, higher at 1,429.05 after falling to 1,421.74 in early trading. Losers led gainers 153 to 90 in a turnover of 19 million shares, down from Wednesday's 30 million.
A minor technical correction in early trading after two days of sharp rises led to a fall of 10 points, but it was recouped and the index closed slightly higher, dealer Ali Raza said.
